show.name: La primera vez
show.summary: A mysterious teen girl arrives at an all-boys school in 1970s Colombia, breaking stereotypes, rules... and a few hearts.

episodes.name: Cartas a un joven poeta
episodes.summary: Eva's return is bittersweet for Camilo, while Luisa's escape from boarding school prompts a reality check for everyone. Salcedo and Castro grow suspicious.

episodes.name: El segundo sexo
episodes.summary: Wrong assumptions favor Camilo, but not for long. Luisa's change of heart sparks a subtle act of rebellion. Trouble brews in Ana and José's marriage.

episodes.name: Cartas a un niño que nunca nació
episodes.summary: The students rally for justice, except Salcedo. A parent-teacher meeting results in a heated debate and a discouraging outcome. Eva has a sneaky idea.

episodes.name: Los viajes de Gulliver
episodes.summary: Grief and joy intertwine in the gang's holiday, with the biggest surprise waiting in Bucaramanga. Ana's wishes to remain solo continue, to Jose's dismay.

episodes.name: Cuando Dios era mujer
episodes.summary: After a promising arrival in Cartagena, Camilo's dreams take a hit — both in love and work. And he's not the only one dealing with unrequited affection.

episodes.name: La revolución sexual
episodes.summary: Camilo strives to win Eva's favor, but an intriguing new figure complicates things for him. As Luisa struggles, she finds comfort in someone unexpected.

episodes.name: Doña flor y sus dos maridos
episodes.summary: Camilo starts to warm up to Alfredo — until he reveals his true intentions. Their new teacher brings knowledge for some and flashbacks for others.

episodes.name: ¡Que viva la música!
episodes.summary: A trippy experience prompts Eva to open up to Camilo, who questions his role in her life. When Rosario opens up, bombshells drop — especially on José.

episodes.name: El orígen de la familia, la propiedad privada y el estado
episodes.summary: Camilo shares what he discovered with the crew. Later on, he and Eva pay a visit to Rosario's home, while José returns home again.

episodes.name: Crímen y castigo
episodes.summary: Eva mobilizes to create the student council. As change looms, Camilo ponders if apparent endings are simply the start of new beginnings.
